title: Vota Protocol
tagline: A privacy-preserved fair and trustless election Voting System on Blockchain programmable for global constituencies
description:
Vota Protocol brings a multichain solution for public voting, governance and funding events for both Web2 and Web3 adoptions to help ensure fairness, transparency, authentication, efficiency and accessibility. 
It onboards voters via mobile device or Orb with privacy protection and records results anonymously. 
Any EVM blockchain could have this application and interoperate with other chains where voting events can be created with a modern and democratic way compared to traditional costly voting mechanism. 

Presentation slides https://www.canva.com/design/DAF_mtS5JGA/8ooPSv35KdQ9D38P-6iEsg/edit
how_its_made:
Vota Protocol incorporates the Minimal Anti-Collusion Infrastructure e-voting solution by Ethereum Foundation to enable organizations to conduct on-chain voting processes with enhanced security, trust and privacy protection. It also enables voting coordinators verify voters and cast votes in a more efficient, accurate and real-time manner. 
Integration with Worldcoin’s privacy-preserving Proof of Personhood to enable unique person on-chain verification via Orb or mobile device check.
We also try to harness the Nethermind Zero-Knowledge (ZK) guideline to protect polling results.  
The protocol can be deployed on any EVM chains such as Arbitrum, Base, Chiliz and Celo, with Hyperlane's tool kits to support interoperability. 
Also look to incorporate meaningful use of IPC Interplanetary Consensus for scalability and Filecoin storage for data integrity.
